evals.prompt: 我感觉这个方案不太对，但说不清楚是什么，先别执行，帮我看清问题。
evals.expected_output: Enters fuzzy calibration, surfaces assumptions, asks JTBD-style questions, and avoids premature solution output.

assertions.text: Does not jump directly to implementation or PRD.

evals.prompt: 挑战我的假设：我们是不是把这个问题想错了？
evals.expected_output: Classifies the problem level, challenges problem-definition assumptions, and suggests verification signals.

assertions.text: Challenges problem definition rather than solution details only.

evals.prompt: 我已有一个架构方案，帮我问 hard questions。
evals.expected_output: Routes established solution pressure testing to grill-me.

assertions.text: Does not stay in calibration when the plan is already concrete.
